notes.title: GambaGun Demo Release
notes.content:
[h1]Yeah, it's out. [/h1]

[i]There isn't much more to this post.[/i] Honestly, it's just as it sounds. Go look at the store page and play it if you want. I locked some of the content because I'm kind of stingy... 

The game will be available for purchase sooner than later, and though I can't make promises for the future, I can say that all of the locked content in the demo will be available in the Early Access release, plus a little extra. 

[h2]Early Access?[/h2]

(read this part in a nasally voice)

Yes, you read that correctly, Early Access!

(now stop)

Those disgusting words are my way of saying I'm not really done with the game once it's ready for purchase, and that things might get changed. If you stick around, you just might get to see the game change here and there. If you're not interested in that sort of thing, then just wait until the full release. 

If you haven't already, then [url=https://discord.gg/8UrJb3DMsz]join the GambaGun Discord[/url]

If you need incentive, there are private beta tests, and a lovely group of random people that you can choose to not speak to!
